narrative.overview:
The approved identity combines Creative Precision, Quiet Contemporary Editorial, Quiet Confidence, and a Thoughtful & Personal voice. English and Arabic have Equal Creative Presence. These commitments come from DESIGN-DECISIONS.md and PRODUCT.md; they do not approve any exact implementation value.

**PROVISIONAL — awaiting user review:** every exact color, font family, type measurement, spacing, radius, layout, breakpoint and motion value in this document and `.impeccable/design.json` records the current local implementation, not an approved brand standard. The frontmatter is the machine-readable record of that trial implementation; source styles remain the implementation source of truth. Palette names describe existing source roles. Do not treat this record as permission to freeze trial decisions.

The shipped expression is an editorial folio using actual public-site and NPark captures, with real local enterprise captures; no schematic substitutes remain. Cool paper, ink, slate blue and ice retain the provisional visual identity. Its surface contract is direction 3, seed `c5af597e`, recorded in `src/index.html`: meet Mahmoud, inspect attributed work, read experience, contact by email. The first viewport's two-part statement, introduction and work action describe the current home composition, not a universal layout requirement.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Color supports readable hierarchy and meaningful project distinction; it does not substitute for verified project evidence.

rules.name: The Equal Presence Rule
rules.body: Arabic receives its own scale, leading and zero display tracking. Use the locale-aware font properties; do not force Latin metrics onto Arabic. Project names and email preserve mixed-script isolation.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep hierarchy in type, space, tonal planes and meaningful dividers rather than introducing ornamental elevation.

dos: Do preserve the approved editorial identity while treating every exact implementation value as PROVISIONAL until user review.
Do use the shared source tokens and language-aware typography for consistent surfaces.
Do preserve attribution, mixed-script isolation, visible focus, reduced motion and keyboard access.
Do preserve real captures and accurately label local sign-in, built-in sample and fallback states.
donts: Don't present trial fonts, colors, layout or motion as approved brand decisions.
Don't add fake product captures, invented outcomes, fake terminal imagery or unavailable download links.
Don't duplicate selectors, add specificity overrides, use !important or preserve obsolete UI code.
Don't turn the home composition or a single project treatment into a universal brand requirement.
